Description.Text:
This example demonstrates how to generate synchronized waveforms with any number of SMC-based PXI waveform generators in the same chassis or any number of SMC-based PCI waveform generators sharing a common RTSI bus. The waveform generators continuously generate synchronized square waves. Immediate trigger is used to start generation on all modules.
Assumptions:
For PXI: Modules must be in one PXI chassis, because the PXI backplane is used for synchronization and trigger distribution. Ensure that the PXI chassis has been properly identified in MAX.
For PCI: Modules must be in one PCI computer, and connected with a RTSI bus because the RTSI bus is used for synchronization and trigger distribution. Ensure that MAX indicates that the cable was created and that synchronized instruments are connected to it.
